items.name: Binary Search Boundary Debugging
items.prompt:
Debug this binary search function to fix the loop condition so it finds target at the high boundary:
```python
def binary_search(arr, target):
    low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while low < high: # Bug here
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target: return mid
        elif arr[mid] < target: low = mid + 1
        else: high = mid - 1
    return -1
```
Correct code:
items.response:
```python

def binary_search(arr, target): 
	if not arr or target < arr[0]: return -1
	if target > arr[-1]: return -1
	low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
	while low <= high: 
		if arr[mid] == target: return mid
		elif arr[mid] < target: low = mid + 1
		else: high = mid - 1
	return -1
```
